emailStatusContract.NOT_REQUESTED: The lifecycle did not request email sending.
emailStatusContract.QUEUED: Odoo accepted the message and exposed outgoing/ready/process evidence.
emailStatusContract.SENT: Odoo exposed terminal sent evidence for the recipient.
emailStatusContract.FAILED: The wizard failed or Odoo exposed exception, bounce, or cancel evidence.
emailStatusContract.UNVERIFIED: The wizard completed but sufficient provider evidence was unavailable.

retryResume.invoice.post: Reuse the existing provider invoice and retry posting only.
retryResume.invoice.send_email: Reuse the existing posted invoice and retry email only.

productionProof: retry-resume proof without a duplicate invoice

sourceNotes: InvoiceRouter uses account.move.send.wizard for headless invoice email execution.
SENT is provider-side transport evidence and does not guarantee recipient inbox delivery.
Current InvoiceRouter v2 Odoo adapter uses Odoo JSON-RPC /jsonrpc.
A future Odoo API migration requires a separately approved change.
